**Progressive High Resolution Ray Casting - Composite:** Generate the current image by compositing $T_{high}$ on top of $T_{low}$ using alpha blending.

The algorithm conservatively approximates the end of ray casting by repeating the iterative process until the computed rays are longer than the diagonal of the volume bounding box.

*   **Global Early Ray Termination (ERT):** Implementing global ERT (stopping ray casting for a pixel entirely if it becomes opaque) requires an extra pass to copy accumulated opacity to a queryable texture.
This extra pass incurs a time penalty larger than the benefits of ERT.
*   **Termination Approximation:** The termination condition (ray length > bounding box diagonal) is conservative.
FBSlabs (Front-to-back Slabs) was proposed in the context of mobile volume rendering, specifically for medical data visualization on devices with limited computational power.
